text:
marta: Quick flag: customers are seeing intermittent 403s on SCIM deprovision after we applied a KMS key-policy tightening patch. Error in audit: 'decrypt: access denied'. Affected tenants: tide-enterprises, ember-labs.

sam: Is it KMS IAM policy or envelope key-version mismatch? Share audit snippet?

marta: Audit line: audit: tenant=tide-enterprises action=deprovision result=deny detail="kms:AccessDeniedException" service=provisioning proxy=idp-proxy-1

jules: We changed key policy to disallow aws:SourceAccount for cross-account decryption last night to tighten principals. Looks like idp-proxy pod role uses STS assume-role from infra-account; the new policy forgot to include that role ARN. So KMS returns AccessDenied when proxy attempts decrypt.

ops-raj: Rolling policy change was staged, but a small fraction of proxy pods still used old role mapping and some used new mapping. That explains intermittent failures.

marta: Mitigation options?

sam: Short term: revert key-policy to previous permissive state while we add the correct role ARNs. Medium: add explicit role ARN to key policy and rotate to new key_version after verifying proxies. Also add an audit field to capture decrypt_caller_arn on failure.

ops-raj: I'll patch key policy to re-allow the assumed-role for idp-proxy-iam-role and notify KMS team. Will do a staged rollout with canary pods to verify decrypt before completing.

jules: Also recommend adding preflight: a KMS decrypt smoke test from each cluster with the actual assumed-role token before policy flip.

sam: Agree. For backfill: requeue failed deprovision jobs once proxies can decrypt. I'll schedule a targeted backfill for the two tenants.

eng-bot: k8s: rolling update idp-proxy group-1 initiated by ops-raj (canary first).

ops-raj: Canary passed, updating key policy now. Requeue jobs queued (job id: bf-20260322-07). Error rate dropped to baseline.

marta: Follow-ups: add decrypt_caller_arn to decrypt audit lines, add preflight assume-role KMS smoke test to rotation playbook, and SEC-465 ticket for policy rollout checklist.

sam: thanks — closing once SEC-465 has owners.
